_doc: Config for tools/strategy_farm/kimi_quota_fetcher.py (OWNER directive 2026-09-15, OWNER-DEC-CBE-20260915 sec30-33). One read-only GET to the SAME managed usage endpoint the official Kimi Code CLI usage panel calls, normalized into state_path. Live-verified 2026-09-15 (docs/ops/evidence/2026-09-15_continuous_book_evolution/design/c2_kimi_quota_fetcher_report.md). Every value here is OWNER/Fable-adjustable; the fetcher hardcodes nothing that lives here. NEVER logs/prints/persists the OAuth token. Kill switch: env QM_KIMI_QUOTA_FETCH=0 -> fetch_status 'disabled' without any network call.
_base_url_doc: Region mainland-cn -> api.kimi.com; global accounts use api.kimi.ai. The installed client honours env KIMI_CODE_BASE_URL as an override; so does this fetcher (base_url_env).
_fetch_me_doc: GET /me carries the plan label (user_level_name, live-verified 'Allegro') plus PII (email/phone/nickname/user_id/global_id/avatar). Only user_level_name/status/region are persisted; every PII field is discarded and never logged.

refresh._doc: The OAuth access_token is a 15-min rolling token. Live-verified 2026-09-15: neither 'kimi provider list' nor 'kimi doctor' refreshes it; only a real authenticated model call (a '-p' prompt) triggers ensureFresh, which costs quota. Re-implementing the OAuth grant against auth.kimi.com is a documented non-goal (brittle client_id, auth-surface risk - see kimi_quota_discovery.md risk 6). Because the 15-min governor fetch mostly runs when the token is already stale (no recent adapter call), a BOUNDED best-effort refresh is now ON by default: when the token is stale AND the last successful fetch is older than min_interval_s AND via_cli is true, the fetcher performs ONE cheap model call (cli_args) then fetches. A successful fetch resets the min_interval clock, so this self-bounds to <=4 refresh calls/day at min_interval_s=21600 (6h) - the documented price of real telemetry per directive sec31-33. A separate refresh_last_utc guard prevents a failing refresh from looping. Set via_cli=false to fully disable (stale token -> auth_error -> ledger fallback, no request).
cli_args: Reply with the single word OK and nothing else.

governor._doc: Real-telemetry thresholds consumed by kimi_governor.compute_state when fetch_status=='ok' and the state is fresh (<= max_state_age_s, i.e. 2x the 15-min governor cadence). Fable-adjustable conservative defaults per directive sec33; they are NOT OWNER Hard Rules and NOT assumed to equal Kimi contractual limits. runaway_guard replaces the old 40/200 call caps as anomaly/runaway-loop protection ONLY - raised so it cannot bind before the real subscription telemetry does (directive sec33: 'do not preserve an arbitrary low ceiling that wastes most of an already-paid subscription' / 'do not remove runaway protection').
